newsitem.title: USA: Sterling COO resigns, meeting delayed.
newsitem.headline: Sterling COO resigns, meeting delayed.

text.p: Sterling Healthcare Group Inc said Paul Auerbach had resigned as chief operating officer and director effective August 30.
The company said in a statement Auerbach had served as Sterling's chief operating officer since June 1995 and as a member of the board of directors since June 1994.
The company said Dr. Stephen Dresnick, the president, chief executive and chairman, had assumed responsibility for day-to-day operations in addition to his other responsibilities.
The company also announced that its special shareholder meeting to consider the merger with FPA Medical Management Inc had been delayed until sometime in October.
